purpose: Select and preserve explicit authority-supported relationship values without disclosing protected target values or mappings.

global_rule.instruction: For every governed field, select the explicit source value whose stated role matches that field, then copy it exactly.

selection_rules.instruction: Choose a candidate because the authority explicitly assigns it the governed field role, not because nearby prose sounds similar.
Do not substitute page type, document type, implementation label, server-card label, link label, or container metadata for the governed value.
Copy the selected lexeme exactly, preserving Unicode marks, casing, whitespace-significant punctuation, delimiters, and identifier fragments.

When authority evidence explicitly supplies a controlled ontology, role, classification, status, or claim token, preserve that token rather than replace it with explanatory prose or a neighboring type.
When multiple candidates exist, prefer the candidate explicitly bound to the governed field and record unresolved ambiguity when no unique binding is supported.
Do not infer a hidden target value from schema shape, prior studies, evaluator expectations, pricing context, or general domain knowledge.
